label: prf:shell-schur-weyl-self-duality
title: Proof of shell schur weyl self duality
html:
Proof. Proof of shell schur weyl self duality

Proof.

We construct the involution in five steps.

1. Classical Schur–Weyl. Classical Schur–Weyl duality between \mathrm{GL}_k(\mathbb{C}) and S_n on V^{\otimes n} bijects \mathrm{GL}_k-irreps V_\lambda^{\mathrm{GL}} and S_n-irreps V_\lambda^{S_n}, both indexed by partitions \lambda \vdash n with at most k rows.

2. \mathrm{GL}_k-duality and transpose. For \lambda \vdash n with conjugate \lambda^*, the \mathrm{GL}_k-module V_{\lambda^*}^{\mathrm{GL}} is isomorphic to the dual of V_\lambda^{\mathrm{GL}} up to a determinant twist: V_{\lambda^*}^{\mathrm{GL}} \cong V_\lambda^{\mathrm{GL},*} \otimes \det^{?}. The transpose \lambda^* implements \mathrm{GL}_k-representation duality.

3. q-deformation. Quantum Schur–Weyl duality extends the classical statement. The Hecke algebra H_n(R, q) replaces S_n, \mathcal{U}_q(\mathfrak{gl}_k) replaces \mathrm{GL}_k, and the pairing V_\lambda^{\mathcal{U}_q} \leftrightarrow V_\lambda^{H_n(R, q)} is preserved. Representation duality on the quantum group side still maps V_\lambda^{\mathcal{U}_q} \mapsto V_{\lambda^*}^{\mathcal{U}_q} (up to q-determinant twist).

4. Hecke-side involution. On the Hecke side, the corresponding involution is tensoring with the sign representation V_{H_n(R, q)}(1^n), which maps V_\lambda \to V_{\lambda^*}. This is an automorphism of H_n(R, q) fixing the Wedderburn blocks pointwise up to the \lambda \leftrightarrow \lambda^* swap.

5. Shell-operator self-duality. The shell operator \sigma_{\mathrm{shell}} is the minimal categorical ingredient realising magic-shell closure at level 4 in the confinement filtration (confinement level). By the braiding compatibility between \mathcal{U}_q(\mathfrak{gl}_k) and H_n(R, q) under Schur–Weyl, any \mathrm{GL}_k-charge-conjugate-invariant construction in the quantum-group category corresponds, under Schur-Weyl transport, to an element of H_n(R, q) fixed by the sign-twist involution. Such elements satisfy x_\lambda = x_{\lambda^*} in the Wedderburn decomposition. \square

Relation to existing propositions. This result refines mass-coefficient-shadow-price (which gives y_\lambda per partition) by asserting the self-dual symmetry of the shell operator. It complements skein-crossing-asymmetry (which encodes the parity-violation mechanism at level 3) by locating the parity-conserving regime at level 4.
